summary: 1. Survey Day 4 (Aug 29) posts a positive gap for the first time since Day 1 — trucks 9,455 BCM against survey 9,951 BCM, +496 BCM (+4.98%) — breaking the two-day negative streak (Days 2-3, -10.69% and -14.52%) that landed directly inside Abel Pienaar's 27-Aug warning that a negative survey would not be accepted again. 2. 2. The MTD-to-target percentage swung sharply in the opposite direction: from +0.37% through Day 3 to -15.15% through Day 4, as Day 1's strong +13.78% reading now carries a smaller share of a four-day average weighed down by two negative days. 3. Survey MTD sits at 74,719 BCM against an 86,036.8 BCM Target MTD, an -11,317.8 BCM shortfall. 3. 4. Trucks-vs-survey MTD reconciles cleanly at -673 BCM (-0.90%), with the trucks side (75,392 BCM) tying exactly to the September Client Meeting Report's own MTD figure through Aug 28 — no new production data landed this pass to extend that tie past day 4. 5. No new Client Meeting Report, DPR, or Daily Availability Final Report landed this pass — production and fleet-availability dashboard figures remain at their Aug 28 (day 4) values from the 94th pass. 6. Only the survey side advanced. 7. The MTD-to-target percentage's single-day swing (+0.37% to -15.15%) is a reminder that this early in a 31-day cycle, the metric is highly sensitive to which one day is carrying the four-day average — worth re-checking for stability once the cycle reaches 7-10 days of data. 8. Day 4's trucks volume (9,455 BCM) reads roughly 40% of the cycle's daily norm, the same same-day filing-lag pattern already flagged for Aug 28's total-production tab in [[daily-production-report]] — confirm at the next pass whether the underlying Client Meeting Report tab fills in higher once fully posted. 9. Two Important References emails (`MINE ACCESS BOOM GATE COMPLIANCE.eml`, `FW_ Refuel Geology Generator.eml`) landed this pass but were not processed — this run stayed dashboard-scoped per the standing pattern. Flagged for the next full "compile mining operations KB" pass. Four files touched since: `Survey Data/Sep 26/260829-INX-SUM.xlsx` (new, Day 4 survey), `Production report/Sep 26/September Distance report.xlsx` (re-touched, Aug 29 tab opens but is still a blank template — no usable data), and the two Important References emails noted above. No new Daily Availability Final Report, Client Meeting Report, or DPR landed. Both new/touched files registered in `RAW/_INGESTED.md` (96th compile pass). [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] updated — new Day 4 dated section, MTD headline refreshed, `Last updated` and `Sources` bumped. [[daily-production-report]] and [[fleet-availability-utilization]] left unchanged — no new source material landed for either this pass. No content removed or renamed. Important References and the Task Feedback Log were not processed this pass (dashboard-scoped, consistent with the 74th/75th/77th/80th/82nd/87th/90th/94th pass pattern).
